decision.message: The esp32_sht31_v1 family with the fast profile exactly matches the request for a wired temperature/humidity controller using SHT31 with 2.2k pull-ups, 400 kHz bus speed, and 100 pF bus loading. Heater off and default supply and ambient conditions are within standard operating bounds.

clauses.text: Build a wired temperature/humidity controller using SHT31, 2.2k pull-ups, a 400 kHz bus and 100 pF total loading.
clauses.reason: Specifies SHT31 sensor with 2.2k pull-ups, 400 kHz bus and 100 pF total loading which matches the esp32_sht31_v1 family fast profile.
Request to keep the heater off is supported by esp32_sht31_v1 heater off requirement.

clauses.text: and use the default supported supply and ambient envelope.
clauses.reason: Default supported supply (3.2-3.4 V, 1000 mA), ambient envelope (10-35 C, 35-60% RH noncondensing indoor air) matches family default operating envelope.
